A '''Bothan [[Relay station/Legends|relay station]]''' was used as a waypoint for recruits hoping to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used the '''relay station''' in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] as a rendezvous point. [[Raleigh Dawn]], [[Sammie Staable]], [[Raal Yorta]], and [[Smileredon-Verdont]] were all led to the station by [[Tay Vanis]].
